legal.title: UK261 delay compensation (summary)
points: UK261 covers flights departing from UK airports.
Compensation is due when a flight arrives at its final destination more than three hours late.
The amount depends on distance: £220 under 1,500 km and £350 for 1,500 to 3,500 km. Over 3,500 km it is £260 for a delay of three to four hours and £520 beyond four hours.
Edinburgh to Faro is about 2,100 km, so the £350 band applies.
No compensation is due if the delay was caused by extraordinary circumstances that could not have been avoided, such as severe weather.
legal.disclaimer: Summary based on the UK Civil Aviation Authority's guidance (caa.co.uk). Not legal advice.
